title: Sidney Bechet and Fletcher Henderson
summary: They recall Ladnier with Fletcher Henderson and a band to England, and Sidney Bechet playing clarinet in Dudley's band.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Sidney Bechet: the man, the horn, the legend

blocks.x: He was with Fletcher Henderson over there for a while. This was before that. Before that, yeah. When he first went.
Yeah, when he was the second time I went there. So he was with Fletcher. Boy Heather made a band there. I think it's Woody something.
I don't know. It was Woody Herman, but he was a clarinet player. No, no, no.
Oh yeah, I know. I think I know now. Woodward. I know the band. I know who you mean. Well, that's what he said. I think Sidney Bechet was with him maybe for a while too. Yes, Sidney.
Sidney used to work with us when I was Mac Devon.
He said he played clarinet. Yeah, clarinet.
Where did he work with you? It was Dudley with my husband.

Oh, Dudley's place. He used to play in his band. Did he work with you in any theater? No, Dudley was a clarinet player. Yes. And he had a band. Well, Sidney went to New York. I knew him quite well. I remember when the first time he saw snow on the ground, he left to go crazy. He'd never seen snow before. I liked Sidney.
He was a funny fellow too.
He was a real, real, real Creole.
But you knew the best of all of them. Sidney Bessie. Yeah, he was a wonderful fellow.
